text.en:
Ang Batas na ito ay magkakabisa sa sandaling
    pagtibayin.

          Pinagtibay,

      NEPTALI A. GONZALES                        RAMON V. MITRA
    Secretary of the Senate                   Speaker of the House
                                               of Representatives

         This Act which originated in the House of Representatives
    was finally passed by the House of Representatives and the Senate
    on October 2, 1991 and February 3, 1992, respectively.

     ANACLETO D. BADOY, JR.                      CAMILO L. SABIO
     Secretary of the Senate                    Secretary General
                                            House of Representatives

    Approved:   APRIL  14, 1992

                            CORAZON C. AQUINO
                       President of the Philippines
